summary: English says 7% per Blue Gem for both Choose branches; both native CountGems steps say Yellow. Runtime follows native (boardGems Yellow). Audit check lightning-extra-turn-source-conflict never clears by code change. Secondary: native counts before CreateGems, runtime reads the count at the extraTurn segment after creation (a Blue Lightning may replace a plain Yellow: 15 Yellow -> 98% instead of 105%). Only fix after the colour is ruled.

Branch DEF: English 'Barrier all other Allies' vs native CauseBarrier AllAllies (ResetTargets). Runtime follows English (allyOthers). Audit check barrier-target-source-conflict never clears by code change; needs a coordinator ruling on which source wins.

DecreaseRandom / StealRandom roll from attack/armor/magic only (src/engine/skills/effects/debuff.ts RANDOM_REDUCE_STATS, comment claims 'official' without a source). IncreaseRandom (buff.ts RANDOM_STATS), trait castEnemyDrain random and aura random use attack/armor/hp/magic. English says 'random Skill(s)'; GoW's four Skills are Attack, Armor, Life, Magic. Community side evidence (gold-primary-sources/community-2017-11-28-quasit-random-skill-life.json) reports a random-skill reduction killing a troop via Life. Not changed unilaterally: affects every DecreaseRandom/StealRandom skill (~35 rows, e.g. troop:6134, 6178, 6198, 6405, 6993, 7135, 7496, 7605, weapon:1104, 1107, 1377). Needs coordinator ruling (3-stat vs 4-stat pool; whether a Life reduction goes through Barrier/Armor).

InflictEffectOnRandomTroops AllEnemies Amount 2,2,2,2,1 bleed was folded into status enemyAll stacks 9 (every enemy 9 layers, 4 applications). Same pattern in 9524/9525 (weapon:1621/1622), plus 9524 damage order.
Damage ran before CauseStun (native order Stun -> Damage): spellblock front enemy took 6 instead of 12 (R001).
Randomize A+(B-C-D-E-F) (Cleanse, Enchant, Magic, Cleanse, Enchant) folded into 3 equal options: Magic 1/3 instead of 1/5, Cleanse/Enchant 1/3 instead of 2/5.

Random status pools differ from official-status-effects.html: negative pool has Charm and lacks Faerie Fire/Hunter’s Mark/Lycanthropy/Terror; default positive pool only barrier/rage/submerged; RandomPositiveStatusEffect pool lists Enrage twice (enraged+rage).
ConvertGems BoardTarget SingleGem (spell Target Board) converted a random gem instead of the chosen one (8722; same in 9197 troop:7480).

Native s0 CountGems Skull uses BoardTarget Block5x5 while s2 ExplodeGems is Block3x3; English says one Barrier per Skull destroyed. Runtime explodes the chosen 3x3 and barriers once per skull destroyed in it (perDestroyed skull). Unclear whether the 5x5 count is intended (explosion radius) or a data quirk; no 5x5-around-cell count source exists. Armor [(Magic x 1.5) + 4] and the explode match.
